description: Strict equality check on floating-point/fixed-point value permanently bricks operations

poc_level_descriptors.L3A: fixed-point arithmetic operation shown producing nonzero value when zero expected
poc_level_descriptors.L3C: strategy bricked: all user withdrawal attempts fail until governance intervention

high_severity_rationale: This bug permanently bricks all strategy operations (deposit, withdraw, rebalance) whenever rounding produces 1 wei. Medium applies because the probability of the rounding condition is dependent on pool state and governance can upgrade the contract.
negative_control_template: Change strict equality to range check: require(_wethAmount <= MAX_DUST_WEI). Verify that 1-wei WETH amounts pass the check and operations proceed normally.
